hook_format.description: The hook format the agent used, from the method's list (e.g. predict-and-commit, forced dilemma). Empty if there was no hook.

hook_headline.description: The hook's headline, as the agent said it.

commitment.description: What the learner committed to after the hook, in the learner's own words. Empty if they didn't commit.

core_idea.description: The core idea the agent stated at the converge step, in one or two sentences. Empty if it never converged.

conclusion.description: The provisional conclusion the agent gave at the converge step.

open_questions.description: The open questions named at the converge step, separated by ' | '.

hints_used.description: How many hints the agent gave when the learner was stuck (nudges, partial answers, or direct explanations).

answer_requested_before_attempt.description: How many times the learner asked for the answer before trying it themselves.

converged.description: True if the agent stated a core idea and a provisional conclusion.
